newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia bourse to lift taxes on summer deals.
newsitem.headline: Croatia bourse to lift taxes on summer deals.

text.p: Croatia's central bourse said on Monday it would not be imposing tax on transactions made in the month to August 14 to stimulate securities trading and boost efficiency of the Croatian capital market.
In a statement faxed to Reuters, the Zagreb Stock Exchange said it hoped brokerages and banks active on the bourse would follow in its footsteps to help reduce the price of the capital on the market.
"Market liquidity and stability are of utmost importance for (the market's) future development," the bourse said.
It hoped temporary lifting of the bourse tax would help brokerages function in an efficient way which should result in an overall cost reduction and more liquid trading.
Trading in summer is considerably slower, due to a reduced interest of buyers and sellers, which results in earlier closing times of brokerages, the bourse said.
Most Croatians close shop in hot summer months of July and August and go to beaches on the Adriatic coast.
